% glossaries-extra with hyperref: abbreviations in the long-short and the
% footnote styles, with \glsxtrshort and \glsxtrlong, and every glossary
% printed by \printglossaries
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\usepackage[abbreviations]{glossaries-extra}
\makeglossaries
\setabbreviationstyle{long-short}
\setabbreviationstyle[note]{footnote}
\newglossaryentry{group}{name={group},
  description={a set with an associative operation}}
\newabbreviation{gcd}{GCD}{greatest common divisor}
\newabbreviation[category=note]{lcm}{LCM}{least common multiple}
\begin{document}
\section{Groups}
A \gls{group}. The \gls{gcd}, then the \gls{gcd}. The \gls{lcm}, then the
\gls{lcm}. In short \glsxtrshort{gcd}, in full \glsxtrlong{lcm}.
\printglossaries
\end{document}
